Class LdapConnectionPoolConfigurer

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.security.ldap.context.LdapConnectionPoolConfigurer
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.context.event.BeanCreatedEventListener<LdapConfiguration>, EventListener
@Internal @Singleton public final class LdapConnectionPoolConfigurer extends Object implements io.micronaut.context.event.BeanCreatedEventListener<LdapConfiguration>
Bounds the JNDI LDAP connection pool for every LdapConfiguration whose manager context is pooled.

The JDK configures its pool with system properties only, read once when the first pooled connection of the JVM is opened, and leaves the pool unbounded by default. This listener runs when an LdapConfiguration bean is created, which precedes the creation of its LdapAuthenticationProvider and therefore the first pooled connection Micronaut Security opens, and, for an enabled configuration, applies LdapConfiguration.ContextConfiguration.PoolConfiguration as the com.sun.jndi.ldap.connect.pool.maxsize, com.sun.jndi.ldap.connect.pool.prefsize and com.sun.jndi.ldap.connect.pool.timeout system properties. A configured value always wins; a value that is not configured keeps a system property that is already set and otherwise falls back to the default.

Since:
5.5.2
Author:
Sergio del Amo

  • Method Details

    • applyDefaults

      public static void applyDefaults()
      Applies the default bound to every pool system property that is not set. DefaultContextBuilder calls this before opening a pooled context, so that a pooled context built outside an LdapConfiguration, through ContextBuilder.build(String, String, String, String, boolean), never uses an unbounded pool either. Properties that are already set, by this listener or on the command line, are left untouched.

    • applyConnectTimeout

      public static void applyConnectTimeout(Map<? super String, ? super String> environment, @Nullable Duration connectTimeout)

      Parameters:
      environment - The JNDI environment of a pooled context
      connectTimeout - The configured connect timeout, or null for the default
